verdict.rationale: Snowflake's docs clearly establish role-based access control (privileges assigned to roles, roles to users) enabling one warehouse/account to serve many teams with governed access, and Secure Data Sharing shows granular object-level sharing. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of column-level masking policies or row-access policies, which are the specific mechanisms the story calls out for column/row-level enforcement. Missing for 10: dynamic data masking / masking policy docs, row access policy docs, and any hands-on or independent verification that these policies compose correctly with RBAC across teams.
